lines: Hardik Suresh Matalia, role unknown, is selling 36,750 shares in the offer for sale, bringing in money from the listing.
Proceeds of ₹1.21 crore are scheduled for On or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026 per the offer document, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Ask whether they plan to keep any holding after the listing, since the retained value is unknown and worth confirming.
Caveat: the gain and pre-offer holding are unknown because the average cost of acquisition and prior holding are not confirmed.
